description: This file defines a C# class 'Css' for managing CSS-related JavaScript interop within a Blazor application. It provides methods to show and hide body overflow by invoking JavaScript functions via IJSRuntime.

classes.name: Css
classes.description: A class to facilitate CSS style manipulations by invoking JavaScript functions from C# in a Blazor application.

methods.name: ShowBodyOverflow
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a JavaScript function to show the body's overflow.

methods.name: HideBodyOverflow
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a JavaScript function to hide the body's overflow and returns the result.
